report_description: TurtleTongue Voice Profile Report. EVERY quest NPC gets voiced — no exceptions. The tier system determines which voice PROFILE is used: Tier 1 = race voice, Tier 2 = creature voice, Tier 3 = custom unique voice, Narrator = books/objects/animals. Description text → quest_giver. Progress + completion text → quest_ender.

faction_leaders.description: One per playable race. Most are also in Tier 3. High Tinker Mekkatorque is the Gnome faction leader; he is NOT in Tier 3 custom voice list — uses generic Gnome voice.

narrator_and_unknown.description: NPCs whose race normalizes to Narrator (animals, novelty, inanimate objects)

narrator_fallback.description: NPCs in the NPC database but whose race could not be determined from DBC files. These will use narrator voice by default. At runtime, UnitRace('npc') may resolve some. Total: still voiced, not excluded.

complete_npc_roster.description: EVERY NPC that speaks any quest text, sorted by total dialogue lines. voice_tier shows which voice profile they use. NO NPC IS EXCLUDED. This is the exhaustive list.
